# RETIRED -- three CMDs in `check_en_r13.py` no longer measure what they claim

This file is additive only. Not one byte of check_en_r13.py beside it has been touched. It exists so that a reader who opens this directory -- without first reaching the retiring record below -- learns the retirement before trusting a green.

## What is retired, and why

Round 14's repair (EN-r-7) made PLACEHOLDER_POPULATION_TABLE_R13.md escape {/} to (/) through one renderer, one rule. That repair is correct and STANDS. Its side effect: no column of the rendered table carries a literal brace byte any more -- and check_en_r13.py:74's count_report() identifies R-38's placeholder population by regex-matching literal { bytes in that same rendered table. Round 14 zeroed the discriminator these three CMDs read the population off.

Three CMDs in check_en_r13.py, all sharing count_report() at line 74, are RETIRED: p37-population (re-counts the population against the rendered table; since round 14 returns a clean 0 that DISAGREES with the record's own hard-coded 1303, FAILS loudly); p37-tokens (re-counts distinct placeholder tokens off the same broken re-count; also FAILS loudly); p37-producers (the silent hazard this project's round 16 exists to catch: core_producers() computes silent = tokens_measured - attributed - unattributed; with the broken count_report() returning tokens_measured={}, silent is trivially empty no matter what the record claims, so this CMD PASSES -- a clean, denominator-bearing agreement with a broken instrument. This is the one a runner who never reads this file will not see).

## The retiring record

org/missions/D14/LGIC/LGIC_ENFORCE/deliverables/0.9.0_WK_LGIC_ENFORCE~1/DISCRIMINATOR_SWEEP_R15.json (committed a08f5000ac, round-15 cell EN-d-1) is the record that retired these three CMDs. Round 15's L9 (3.0.0_SA_CVO @c6ac61b33a) confirmed the residual this marker exists to close.

## What a real re-point needs, and why it is not done here

A working re-point exists in principle: point count_report() at the raw canonical field of NAMING_CENSUS_REPORT.r13.md's fenced JSON rows instead of the rendered, now-escaped table bytes. Making that real means editing check_en_r13.py -- a PINNED FIXED INPUT OF A CLOSED ROUND, which would ACTIVELY ENDANGER something graded (round-15 L9). Named for this fixed input's owner, 2.0.0_SA_COO~G.

## What this marker does NOT close

This file does not stop p37-producers from returning PASS. Anyone who runs the CMD directly still gets a green; this marker raises the floor only for a reader who opens the directory.
